tools.name: latest_alerts
tools.description: FREE. Latest 5 UK food recalls and allergy alerts from the Food Standards Agency, optional keyword (product, brand, allergen).

tools.name: alert_search
tools.description: PRO. Full alert detail (products, batch codes, best-before, risk statement) for alerts matching keyword/allergen/type over the last ~200 alerts.

tools.name: watchlist
tools.description: PRO. Check a list of brands/suppliers/products you stock (up to 100) against recent alerts — for retailers, caterers, wholesalers.

tools.name: new_since
tools.description: PRO. Alerts published since a date (default yesterday) — daily check for your agent.
